tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere — warm scrapbook paper (light) or the darkroom (dark). Carries the grain overlay.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, the upload drop zone and other surfaces one layer above paper. Roll cards use scrap.

tokens.name: scrap
tokens.usage: Aged paper scrap behind roll cards: torn edges, faint ruled lines. ink, ink-muted, pin and keeper all read on it (4.5:1+) in both themes.

tokens.name: scrap-edge
tokens.usage: The darker fibre line along a scrap's torn edge. Decorative only.

tokens.name: scrap-rule
tokens.usage: Faint ruled lines on a scrap, like old notebook paper. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between rows. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and the dashed upload outline — 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, outline-button borders, doodle strokes. Reads on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: camera, dates, hints, labels. On paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: THE brand colour, a deep muted indigo: primary buttons, links, the active tab, focus rings, stickers, the footer band. 8:1+ as text on paper and paper-raised in both themes. Use it for at most one filled control per screen, plus stickers.

tokens.name: cobalt-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of cobalt fills; darker details inside stickers.

tokens.name: cobalt-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind cobalt text; the upload zone while a file hovers over it.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid cobalt fill (primary button, footer band). 7:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: print
tokens.usage: The white border of a photo print and the label band on a film canister. Stays light in the darkroom theme, like a real print on a dark table.

tokens.name: on-print
tokens.usage: Captions and handwritten notes written on a print's border or a canister label.

tokens.name: on-print-muted
tokens.usage: Dates and small metadata on a print's border.

tokens.name: on-print-pin
tokens.usage: An 'oops' note written on a print's border in red pen.

tokens.name: pin
tokens.usage: The oops colour: push-pins, oops stamps and notes, error text. Safelight red in the darkroom. As text, on paper, paper-raised and pin-soft. Links, focus and primary actions use cobalt.

tokens.name: pin-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind pin text, like an oops note.

tokens.name: on-pin
tokens.usage: Text on a solid pin fill (solid oops stamp, pin badge).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset. Alias of cobalt, at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: keeper
tokens.usage: 'Keeper' status — a frame you love. Always paired with the word keeper. As text, on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: on-keeper
tokens.usage: Text on a solid keeper fill.

tokens.name: film
tokens.usage: Film-strip base (the dark celluloid between frames and around sprocket holes).

tokens.name: film-hole
tokens.usage: Sprocket holes. Paper in light; in the darkroom they glow like a lightbox.

tokens.name: film-edge
tokens.usage: Edge-print text on the film rail: frame numbers (12, 12A) and the stock line. Only on film.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Masking tape holding a featured print. Translucent — lets the print show through.

tokens.name: stock-gold
tokens.usage: Canister body for warm colour-negative stocks (the yellow-box kind). Decorative fill only, always with the ISO label beside it.

tokens.name: stock-green
tokens.usage: Canister body for cool colour-negative stocks (the green-box kind).

tokens.name: stock-blue
tokens.usage: Canister body for slide / reversal stocks.

tokens.name: stock-mono
tokens.usage: Canister body for black-and-white stocks.

tokens.name: stock-rose
tokens.usage: Canister body for everything else: cine, redscale, expired mystery rolls.

tokens.name: stock-red
tokens.usage: Canister body, preset only (CAN-2 "Red"). Decorative fill.

tokens.name: stock-orange
tokens.usage: Canister body, preset only (CAN-2 "Orange"). Decorative fill.

tokens.name: stock-cream
tokens.usage: Canister body, preset only (CAN-2 "Cream"). Needs the canister's line-strong edge to read on paper.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Landing page hero headline only, once. Serif (Fraunces). Drops to display-l (40px) under 600px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the roll or album title on desktop. Drops to display-mobile under 600px.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section titles on desktop. Under 600px, page titles use display-mobile instead.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Roll-card names, dialog titles on desktop. Drops to title-mobile under 600px.

styles.name: display-mobile
styles.usage: Page titles on phones (under 600px): replaces display-xl and display-l. One per screen.

styles.name: title-mobile
styles.usage: Section, sheet and dialog titles on phones (under 600px): replaces title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Shot the whole roll at box speed, forgot it was ISO 800.
styles.usage: All running text and inputs on desktop. Under 600px use body-mobile (14px).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary UI copy, list rows on desktop. Under 600px use body-sm-mobile (13px).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, nav, tabs — always uppercase.

styles.name: body-mobile
styles.sample: Shot the whole roll at box speed, forgot it was ISO 800.
styles.usage: Replaces body under 600px: running text, list-row names, inputs and buttons on phones.

styles.name: body-sm-mobile
styles.usage: Replaces body-sm under 600px: secondary copy, hints, small buttons on phones.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: All film and camera data: stock, ISO, exposures, dates, camera, lens.

styles.name: edge
styles.usage: Edge print on film rails and stamps, uppercase.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Human notes only: captions, oops notes, the one scribble per section.

styles.name: note-sm
styles.usage: Captions on small prints and film frames.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, stamp padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to input, caption to print.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Print border (classic), input side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; card padding; grid gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gap on desktop; section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Instant-print bottom border; between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Prints, photos and buttons — real prints have square corners, and so do our buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Film frames, stamps, canister bodies.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The upload drop zone and sheets on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Push-pins and avatar dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-print
tokens.usage: Every print lying on paper. The only resting shadow in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A print on hover or while dragged.

tokens.name: shadow-pin
tokens.usage: The push-pin head.

tilt.note: Rotation for scrapbook moments. Only prints, tape and the doodle button tilt — never text blocks, inputs or grids in list views.

tokens.name: tilt-none
tokens.usage: Prints in grids and on mobile.

tokens.name: tilt-left
tokens.usage: Featured print, tape strips.

tokens.name: tilt-right
tokens.usage: Second print in a collage, so neighbours don't match.

tokens.name: tilt-wild
tokens.usage: At most one per page: the hero print or a sticker.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Paper grain over the page background. Never over photos.
